_about: Clinic heal game `hair` (H16 The beetles; docs/modes/clinic-design.md, H16 and decision 1: tiny round beetles with big eyebrows, never called lice). A close-up of the patient's head with a big mop of hair (a bald patient gets Ali's hair), nine beetles peeking out of it, three of each colour. Rows: [Comb it] {num} [times] (a swipe on the hair is one stroke); {num} [red ones] (tap them into the jar); level 2 a second colour, ne poi; level 3 ne poi [shampoo], {num} [rubs]. Real Kutchi is only the numbers (num-01..05, screen spelling hakro, ba, trae, char, panj: docs/kutchi-grammar-notes.md, data/cook.json) and ne poi; hakro is the he-form (the beetle's word is still a placeholder, so its gender is unknown: check with the family). Colours have no Kutchi word yet: they are placeholders. The tray ids: comb (data/clinic.json), bug-jar (a rough sprite), shampoo (placeholder). Levels are data.

beetles.english: beetles in the hair (tiny, round, with big eyebrows)

itchy.english: Itchy, itchy! Something's in my hair!

1._note: The comb (a count) + one colour caught into the jar (a count of a colour). Lines one at a time. Blind: 1/3 x 1/3 x 1/3.

2._note: The comb + two colours in order (ne poi): the second colour's beetles after the first's. Said as one list.

3._note: + ne poi [shampoo], a count of rubs (tap the head).
